4ae924e6.text:
Your first stop should be Ironforge which can be reached via the technological marvel known as the Deeprun Tram.

You can find the entrance to the tram in the Dwarven District here in Stormwind, just to the southwest of the keep. The tram will transport you safely to the heart of Ironforge City.

Once you arrive, explore the city and locate High Tinker Mekkatorque and King Magni Bronzebeard in Tinker Town and the Great Forge, respectively. Introduce yourself as an agent of the $R and they will show you their hospitality.
4ae924e6.title: Advisor Emerson's Instructions

5c8c56b7.text:
After you've become acquainted with the other leaders of the alliance, Lord Fordragon has requested that you report back to him here in the keep.

I wish you good fortune in your journeys, $R.
5c8c56b7.title: Advisor Emerson's Instructions

79eb1dce.text:
The city of Darnassus can be found across the sea, off the coast of northern Kalimdor. The city itself rests at the top of the great tree, Teldrassil.

The safest route for you currently is via the harbor on the west side of Stormwind. Take the ship departing from the southernmost dock to the port of Auberdine.

Upon arriving, proceed to the north side of the Auberdine docks and take the ship there to Ru'theran Village. This village contains a magical transporter that will take you into the city itself.

Explore Darnassus and seek out Tyrande Whisperwind, the High Priestess of Elune.
79eb1dce.title: Advisor Emerson's Instructions

ed4434f9.text:
Greetings,

As a guest of the Alliance, you have been given leave to travel freely throughout Alliance lands. 

This document will serve as a guide to help you reach the other member cities of our alliance.
ed4434f9.title: Advisor Emerson's Instructions

233|f729d74e.name: Farmer Saldean
233|f729d74e.text: Rough times, huh, $N? No matter where you turn someone needs help, and my wife and I are no exception.

235|f83ef93f.name: Salma Saldean
235|f83ef93f.text: Welcome to our humble abode!  It's always nice to see a friendly face.  And what strong arms you have.  My husband and I are always looking for help around the farm.  Now that most the good folk have left, it's hard to find an able body to help out.

253092|e0247c5d.name: Alba Fairmoon
253092|e0247c5d.text:
I am told the farms of Westfall once supplied a bounty of crops for Stormwind. But now, the soil is barren and most of the farmers have fled.

On behalf of Darnassus I would like to offer my aid in replenishing this land. Will you assist me?

392|9183bb21.name: Captain Grayson
392|9183bb21.text: Do not be alarmed, $r.  I have long since passed from this land but I intend no harm to your kind.  I have witnessed too much death in my time.  My only wish now is for peace.  Perhaps you can help my cause.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

8931|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Heather
8931|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

102-progress.name: Captain Danuvin
102-progress.text: Have you collected 8 paws from those treacherous Gnolls yet?
102-progress.title: Patrolling Westfall

103-progress.name: Captain Grayson
103-progress.text: The flame will not burn for long without oil, $N.
103-progress.title: Keeper of the Flame

104-progress.name: Captain Grayson
104-progress.text:
Have you laid waste to the menace known as Old Murk-Eye yet?  He has been spotted roaming the coastline of Westfall.

Return to me when the foul beast is dead.
104-progress.title: The Coastal Menace

12-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
12-progress.text: Perhaps I did not make myself clear, pledge.  In order to prove your worth as a servant to The People's Militia and to the Light you need to slay 15 Defias Trappers and 15 Defias Smugglers then return to me when the deed is done.
12-progress.title: The People's Militia

151-progress.name: Verna Furlbrow
151-progress.text: Old Blanchy is on her last leg.  Did you happen to find any oats for her?
151-progress.title: Poor Old Blanchy

153-progress.name: Scout Galiaan
153-progress.text: Bring me 15 red leather bandanas and I'll pay you well.
153-progress.title: Red Leather Bandanas

22-progress.name: Salma Saldean
22-progress.text: All I need for my famous meat pie are 8 Goretusk Livers!
22-progress.title: Goretusk Liver Pie

36-progress.name: Salma Saldean
36-progress.text: I'm going to miss that Verna Furlbrow so much.  I don't suppose you happened to see her on your way here?
36-progress.title: Westfall Stew

38-progress.name: Salma Saldean
38-progress.text:
Come back with the following ingredients: 
 
 3 Stringy Vulture Meat 
 3 Goretusk Snouts 
 3 Murloc Eyes 
 3 Okra
38-progress.title: Westfall Stew

64-progress.name: Farmer Furlbrow
64-progress.text: Don't suppose you were able to get my watch?
64-progress.title: The Forgotten Heirloom

92744-progress.name: Alba Fairmoon
92744-progress.text: I hope the murlocs did not give you too much trouble?
92744-progress.title: Murloc Gills

92909-progress.name: Ozwin Ironsprocket
92909-progress.text: It's a mess out there, $N! Did you collect the parts I need?
92909-progress.title: Harvesting the Harvesters
